import numpy as np
def comps_of(g,color):
    a=np.array(g); h,w=a.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(a,bool); res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if a[i,j]==color and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=True; comp=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and a[ny,nx]==color and not seen[ny,nx]:
                            seen[ny,nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[q[0] for q in comp]; xs=[q[1] for q in comp]
                o=[[int(a[y,x]) for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)] for y in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1)]
                res.append(((min(ys),min(xs)),set(comp),o))
    return res

import numpy as np,collections,json
def comps(g,col):
    a=np.array(g); h,w=a.shape; seen=np.zeros_like(a,bool); res=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if a[i,j]==col and not seen[i,j]:
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i,j]=True; comp=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                        if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and a[ny,nx]==col and not seen[ny,nx]:
                            seen[ny,nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                ys=[q[0] for q in comp]; xs=[q[1] for q in comp]
                o=[[int(a[y,x]) for x in range(min(xs),max(xs)+1)] for y in range(min(ys),max(ys)+1)]
                res.append(((min(ys),min(xs)),o))
    return res
for name,col in [('Demo pair 1',1),('Demo pair 2',2)]:
    c=comps(G[name+' input'],col)
    H,W=G[name+' output'].shape
    print(name,'out',(H,W))
    info=[]
    for pos,o in c:
        rr,cc=pos
        hh,ww=len(o),len(o[0])
        cells=[(r-rr,c-c c_) for r_,c_ in [(r,c) for r in range(hh) for c_ in range(ww) if o[r][c_]]]
        rs=[x[0] for x in cells]; cs=[x[1] for x in cells]
        rmin,rmax=min(rs),max(rs); cmin,cmax=min(cs),max(cs)
        zeros_inside={(r,c) for r in range(rmin,rmax+1) for c in range(cmin,cmax+1)} - set(cells)
        # connectivity of zero-regions inside bbox (4-conn through zeros, can exit bbox)
        z=set(zeros_inside); out=False; empty=True
        if not z: continue
        import collections
        q=collections.deque([next(iter(z))]); seenz={}; 
        while q:
            y,x=q.popleft()
            if not (rmin<y<rmax and cmin<x<cmax): out=True
            if (y,x) in seenz: continue
            seenz.add((y,x))
            for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                if (ny,nx) in z and (ny,nx) not in seenz: q.append((ny,nx))
        feats=dict(pos=rr,cells_n=len(cells),bb=(hh,ww),cell_count=hh*ww-len(cells),open_zeros=out)
        info.append(feats)
    chos=[p for p,o in c if o==G[name+' output']]
    for feat in 'pos,cells_n,bb,cell_count,open_zeros'.split(','):
        vals=[i[feat] for i in info]
        mark='*' if chos[0][feat] in vals else ''
        print(feat,mark,[v for v in vals])
